reason: I'd probably go for the free first visit, but $13 a kid adds up fast on one income with shifts, and the library and parks cost nothing. I can't see paying that every week.
objection: $13 per kid per visit is too much when free places exist, and with two kids it's $20 before I buy anything.
would_change_my_mind: A weekday drop-in around $8 per child, or a cheap multi-visit pack that works out to under $8 a visit.
